drn_pooled.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)

drn_pooled.fitting: one network for the four months (pooled_benchmark.py), otherwise as the DRN

accepted.note: one network for the four months of a cycle (month position one-hot, whole years held out), against the published pipeline, with the per-target DRN and EMOS of the second stage as comparisons; CRPS scoring version 2.
